description: Boundary coverage for broadcasting every change to all observers: the minimum multi-observer fan-out of two observers receiving one change, observers attached at different times so a later observer starts from the current value and then both receive subsequent changes in attachment order, and a wider fan-out of four observers all receiving the same single change. Each set delegates exactly one store write and then notifies all active observers in attachment order.
